title: Ukraine's Former Top General: Russia's Offensive Capability Is 'Broken'
detail: Ukraine's former commander-in-chief, General Valery Zaluzhny, told the BBC that Russia's offensive capability has been 'broken', suggesting Moscow is increasingly unable to sustain major advances. The assessment points to mounting attrition in Russian forces and signals a potential shift in the war's trajectory.

media.caption: Ukraine's former top general says Russia's offensive capability is 'broken'
